fairness_notes: Primary comparison is one-shot Blob to newly returned Blob. Include fresh digest/buffer creation and finalization in the Mops measured operation, as fromBlob does.
Use identical prepared pseudorandom Blob inputs, the same compiler, flags, core, RTS, PocketIC version and measurement boundaries for both implementations.
Perform input creation, forced-GC preparation, digest verification and reply encoding outside the measured region; retain output to prevent elimination.
Do not replace fromBlob with stateful fold/combineNodes/combineLeaves APIs for the primary comparison; these have different input/state contracts.
Mops README recommends random inputs because repeated-byte inputs can distort instruction counts.
